svg.text: The painter’s wheel vs your eye
The art-class wheel was built for mixing paint, not for reading data

svg.text: Built for mixing paint. Its complementary pair is red–green.
Red and green share one channel: 1 in 12 men can’t separate them.

svg.text: Built for reading. Equal steps should look equally different.
